NONE: B2 firm and not changing in your friendship with or support for a person or an organization, or in your belief in your principles

example: Jack has been a loyal worker in this company for almost 50 years.
傑克是這間公司忠誠的員工，已經工作了快50年了。
When all her other friends deserted her, Steve remained loyal.
當其他朋友都離她而去的時候，史蒂芬依然對她不離不棄。
She's very loyal to her friends.

NONE: › a person or group that strongly supports the government or ruler in power
› in Northern Ireland, a person who believes that Northern Ireland should continue to be part of the UK

example: The rebel forces have been repeatedly attacked by loyalist troops.
叛軍遭到了忠於政府的部隊的連番攻擊。

U: B2 [ U ] the quality of being loyal

example: His loyalty was never in question.
